in_sanskrit.name: सर्वन्
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Sarvan is a Sanskrit name that means 'all,' 'entire,' or 'complete.' It is derived from the Sanskrit root 'sarv' which means 'all.' Sarvan is a powerful name that signifies completeness and wholeness.

in_hindi.name: सर्वान
in_hindi.long_meaning: Sarvan in Hindi is written as 'सर्वान' and is pronounced as 'sarvān.' The name 'सार्व' in Hindi means 'all,' 'entire,' or 'complete.' Sarvan is a popular name in India and is often used for boys.

in_tamil.name: சர்வன்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Sarvan in Tamil is written as 'சர்வன்' and is pronounced as 'charvan.' The name 'சர்வ' in Tamil means 'all,' 'entire,' or 'complete.' Sarvan is a unique and powerful name in Tamil culture.

in_telugu.name: శర్వణ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Sarvan in Telugu is written as 'శర్వణ్' and is pronounced as 'sharvaṇ.' The name 'శర్వ' in Telugu means 'all,' 'entire,' or 'complete.' Sarvan is a respected name in Telugu culture and is often used for boys.
